blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many travellers, discovering the full variety of Tanzania is a long-held dream. Think of epic Tanzania safari trips looking for Africa’s Big Five, a climb of Kilimanjaro or unwinding on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find all of it in Tanzania. Better still, Your Tanzania Trip can create a custom made itinerary that matches everything you are hoping for.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking for ideas? Our most popular itineraries are a good place to start. Many of our clients choose to finish their exciting safari with a few restful days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Is that something you would enjoy too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or shape your own journey; either way, we are glad to help. Come along and prepare to discover Tanzania at a pace that suits you, in exactly the way you want!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you leave Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide is there to greet you with a wide smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' Your guide drives you directly to your hotel so you can settle in and enjoy the African atmosphere. The following day you set off together on an exclusive, private safari, so you travel at the pace you prefer. You have the comfort of a safari jeep to yourself, and you are free to stop and look at the animals for as long as you want!

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Tarangire National Park is known for its large elephant herds and its vast number of giant baobab trees. These baobabs can survive for hundreds of years, and in the dry season they even supply elephants with water, which the elephants extract using a special technique. What is more, the Tarangire River is the only water source in the dry season, so during this period you can find herds of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire, as well as many other animals!

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park has a reputation as the place for a safari, mostly thanks to the Great Migration that crosses it. The huge charging herds are impressive, and so is the number of predators living here: more than four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! Of course there are lots of other lovely animals as well, and your guide will be happy to go looking for them with you. Are you ready for it?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The renowned Ngorongoro Crater is counted among Africa's seven natural wonders. It was created two million years ago by the eruption of a huge volcano. The rich lava formed a unique ecosystem that now supports the highest concentration of animals anywhere in Africa! Down in the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the views are so astonishing you won’t know where to look first!

blocks.orig: Today you fly to the spice island of Zanzibar. Our guide picks you up at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Over the next few days, you can discover white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. Into culture? Then head to Stone Town and dive into the history of this fascinating little town. Food lovers can also visit the spice plantations and discover the diverse flavours of the delicious local cuisine. A tropical paradise awaits you!
blocks.html: Today you take a flight to Zanzibar, the spice island. At the airport our guide collects you and brings you to your hotel. In the days that follow you can enjoy white sandy beaches, clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Interested in culture? Then go to Stone Town and immerse yourself in the past of this intriguing little town. If you love food, you can also visit the spice plantations and get to know the many flavours of the tasty local cuisine. A tropical paradise is waiting for you!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: This is paradise at its finest: lovely, tropical Zanzibar! With the clear blue Indian Ocean and white sandy beaches lined with palm trees, it almost seems too good to be real. Get a fresh coconut drink on the beach, sunbathe or swim for hours, and try the tasty Zanzibari dishes. Feeling active? Then discover the island, the beach and the ocean with a variety of activities! We can warmly recommend a tour of Stone Town or the Safari Blue Cruise.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on when you fly, you can relax on the beach or see a little more of the island. After that, head to Zanzibar International Airport in good time for your flight home. Not ready to leave? You can also extend your holiday on another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
